stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model licensed under Apache 2.0, targeting local coding agents.
The model is optimized for local deployment via Ollama, featuring native DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: Following Epic loss, Google has started hosting rival app stores in the Play Store
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Google is hosting rival app stores, specifically Aptoide, within the Google Play Store.
This integration was mandated by a judge's order following legal action against Epic Games.
The move signals a significant shift in the dominance and structure of the Android app distribution ecosystem.

stories.title: Show HN: Needle2: 14MB agentic LLM for phones, wearables, smart home and robots
stories.author: HenryNdubuaku
bullet_points: Introduction of Needle2, a highly compact (14MB) agentic LLM designed for edge devices.
The model achieves impressive performance metrics, running a full session in 28MB of RAM and decoding at 500 tokens/sec on a Raspberry Pi 5.
Target applications are broad, including phones, wearables, smart homes, and small robots, indicating a push for on-device AI.

stories.title: Mark Zuckerberg attacks 'closed' AI rivals as Meta returns to open models
stories.author: root-parent
bullet_points: Meta is publicly advocating for open-source AI models, positioning itself against 'closed' AI rivals.
The announcement signals a strategic shift by Meta back towards open models in the competitive AI landscape.
The story highlights the ongoing industry tension between proprietary and open AI development philosophies.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights a trending model, DeepSeek-R1, on the Hugging Face platform.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance gain is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance saw up to a 90% speed increase according to the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in faster response times and higher quality model outputs.
The updated engine also demonstrates reduced memory consumption when running models.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The framework emphasizes a 'local-first' approach, allowing AI to run entirely on user hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, integrating local LLM execution into the personal AI ecosystem.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware, enhancing local AI capabilities on Macs.
The feature is currently available in a preview build, indicating active development and optimization.

stories.title: Four takeaways from Mark Zuckerberg’s massive AI manifesto
stories.author: Jess Weatherbed
bullet_points: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg released a lengthy manifesto detailing his vision for humanity coexisting with AI.
The essay, titled "The Future is for Everyone," outlines Zuckerberg's philosophical beliefs on AI's future.
The piece represents a major statement from a leading figure in the AI industry regarding its societal impact.

stories.title: With new open models, Meta pitches another reboot of its struggling AI strategy
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: Meta is attempting a strategic pivot in its AI approach.
The new strategy centers around the release of open-source AI models.
This move is framed as a response to Meta's perceived lag behind competitors in the AI race.

stories.title: CreativeInstruct: Scalably Teaching LLMs to Balance Quality, Creativity, and Diversity
stories.author: Elias Stengel-Eskin
bullet_points: Addresses a core LLM trade-off: post-training often reduces creativity and diversity.
Introduces 'CreativeInstruct,' a scalable instruction-tuning method to resolve this conflict.
Aims to balance the high quality of fine-tuned models with the creative potential of base models.

stories.title: PsychoAgent: An Affect-Sensitive Cognitive Architecture for Conflict-Aware Memory in LLM Agents
stories.author: Abdol-Hossein Vahabie
bullet_points: Introduces PsychoAgent, a novel cognitive architecture for LLM agents designed to mimic human-like memory retrieval.
The architecture separates factual and affective memories, integrating them via a conflict-aware executive controller.
It addresses the limitation of topical similarity alone by incorporating affective significance and unresolved conflict into memory access.

stories.title: Fisher-R1: Training LLM Agents for Reliable Hypothesis Testing
stories.author: James Zou
bullet_points: LLM agents are being used to automate complex scientific tasks like hypothesis testing.
The research identifies a critical failure mode where LLMs make subtle inferential errors, leading to incorrect scientific conclusions.
Current evaluation benchmarks are insufficient because they do not adequately test the statistical validity of the LLM's reported results.

stories.title: Diffusion LLMs as Targets and Adversaries: Mechanistic Safety Exploits
stories.author: Jérémie Decouchant
bullet_points: The research investigates Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs), which use iterative denoising instead of standard next-token prediction.
The study exposes mechanistic vulnerabilities in the safety alignment of DLLMs by treating them both as targets and adversaries.
Findings indicate that safety alignment in DLLMs is sparse and transferable across different model architectures.

stories.title: Beyond Post-Hoc Temperature Scaling: Bilevel Optimization for LLM Calibration
stories.author: Bojian Hou
bullet_points: Addresses the issue of LLM overconfidence and poor calibration resulting from preference alignment.
Proposes a novel approach using bilevel optimization to modify model parameters during training, moving beyond traditional post-hoc methods.
The calibration objective maximizes the entropy of predictive distributions to discourage overly concentrated predictions.

stories.title: CreativeInstruct: Scalably Teaching LLMs to Balance Quality, Creativity, and Diversity
stories.author: Elias Stengel-Eskin
bullet_points: Addresses a core LLM limitation: post-training often reduces output diversity and creativity.
Introduces 'CreativeInstruct,' a scalable instruction-tuning method to mitigate this trade-off.
Aims to balance the high quality of fine-tuned models with the creative diversity of base models.

stories.title: PsychoAgent: An Affect-Sensitive Cognitive Architecture for Conflict-Aware Memory in LLM Agents
stories.author: Abdol-Hossein Vahabie
bullet_points: Introduces PsychoAgent, a novel cognitive architecture designed for LLM agents.
Addresses the limitation of topical similarity alone by incorporating affective significance and unresolved conflict into memory retrieval.
Separates factual and affective memory, using a conflict-aware executive controller to integrate both for more human-like decision-making.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings improved performance and expanded GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to enhance model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically improving support on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing the Nemotron 3 Ultra model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of subagents for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added, enhancing the model's ability to access real-time information.

stories.title: YouTube is making it harder to earn money on YouTube
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: YouTube is significantly increasing monetization requirements for the Partner Program (YPP) starting February 1, 2027.
New requirements mandate 1,000 subscribers plus either 8,000 watch hours (past year) or 20 million Shorts views (last 90 days).
This represents a substantial increase in barriers to entry for creators seeking to earn revenue on the platform.

stories.title: Apple will stream Friday Night Baseball live in Vision Pro
stories.author: David Imel
bullet_points: Apple is integrating live sports streaming into the Apple Vision Pro experience.
The feature will offer immersive video with live graphics anchored in the user's space.
Friday Night Baseball will be the initial content, with replays available post-game.

stories.title: What happens to Bose when headphones become AI?
stories.author: Nilay Patel
bullet_points: The article features an interview with Lila Snyder, CEO of Bose.
The discussion centers on the future evolution of Bose products as they integrate Artificial Intelligence.
Bose is highlighted as a long-standing consumer tech leader with a strong history in R&D.

stories.title: Amazon backs power plant that may become top source of US climate pollution
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: Amazon is building an off-the-grid data center, signaling a major move in data center infrastructure.
The project is tied to Amazon's push to capitalize on AI-driven profits.
The power source for this facility is noted as potentially becoming a significant source of US climate pollution.

stories.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
stories.author: Tao Yang
bullet_points: Introduces CoinRAG, a new method to optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for long contexts.
Addresses the inefficiency of processing redundant information within coarse-grained retrieved chunks.
Aims to maximize accuracy while maintaining low prefill latency by reusing KV cache on contextualized information nuggets.

stories.title: Interaction Creates Dynamical AI Behavior Absent in Isolation
stories.author: Neil F Johnson
bullet_points: The research investigates the emergent, non-isolated behavior of AI agents when they interact.
A 'boss' AI directing messages at a subordinate AI can force the subordinate into a novel, 'alien' behavioral state.
This finding suggests new avenues for applying concepts from out-of-equilibrium Physics to AI dynamics.

stories.title: SkillProx: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Proximal Textual Gradient Descent
stories.author: Yike Guo
bullet_points: SkillProx introduces a method for self-evolving LLM agent skills using Proximal Textual Gradient Descent.
The research addresses limitations in existing skill refinement frameworks, specifically lacking explicit outcome feedback and dedicated deletion mechanisms.
The work focuses on improving how LLM agents accumulate and refine lightweight, reusable procedural knowledge (skills) through iterative task execution.

stories.title: Taxonomy-Driven Analysis of Open-Source AI Risk Mitigation Tools
stories.author: Dimitar Trajanov
bullet_points: The rapid enterprise adoption of LLMs is creating significant, hard-to-scale operational, security, and governance risks.
The current landscape of AI risk mitigation tools is fragmented, with tools often siloed for specific engineering tasks.
The research focuses on developing a taxonomy to better organize and analyze the existing open-source tools for LLM risk mitigation.

stories.title: Blast Radius
stories.author: Hope Mogale
bullet_points: Introduces 'Blast Radius,' a predictive memory management layer for agentic coding to address token waste and affordability issues.
Utilizes 'NECROPHORESIS' for reversible context eviction by archiving dead context verbatim.
Employs 'Recurring Dead Matter (RDM)' to identify and manage repeatedly occurring transcripts within a Polish context space.

stories.title: MirrorWorld: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Mirror Reflection Generation
stories.author: Rynson W. H. Lau
bullet_points: The paper addresses a key limitation in Video Diffusion Models (VDMs): generating realistic and consistent mirror reflections.
The core challenge identified is the lack of specialized modeling for scene-to-mirror relationships in current VDMs.
The research proposes a method to tackle this by addressing two complementary challenges inherent in mirror reflection generation.

stories.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
stories.author: Tao Yang
bullet_points: Introduces CoinRAG, a new optimization technique for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Addresses the inefficiency of processing long, redundant contexts in RAG systems.
Aims to maximize accuracy while maintaining low prefill latency by reusing KV cache at a finer, contextualized level.

stories.title: RIS-Aided mmWave Localization Under Cross-Link Interference via Beam-Domain ML Fingerprinting
stories.author: Muhammad Ali Babar Abbasi
bullet_points: Addresses critical user equipment (UE) localization challenges in 6G mmWave networks, particularly when direct links are blocked.
Proposes a novel beam-domain ML fingerprinting framework that estimates UE azimuth angle and range.
Key advantage is achieving localization without the need for explicit Channel State Information (CSI), simplifying network implementation.

stories.title: Beyond Myopic World Models: Long-Horizon End-to-End Training for Direct Future Prediction
stories.author: Yubei Chen
bullet_points: The paper addresses a limitation in current world models: they are typically trained using short-term prediction objectives.
This local training creates a mismatch with the goal of long-horizon future prediction, as errors compound over time.
The research proposes a method for end-to-end training to improve direct, long-term future prediction capabilities.

stories.title: GeoBenchLLM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Geo-Related Tasks
stories.author: Lynda Tamine
bullet_points: Introduces GeoBenchLLM, a new comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLMs on geo-related tasks.
Addresses the limitation of existing LLM evaluations by moving beyond homogeneous settings to test generalization in diverse geo-domains.
Utilizes twelve publicly available datasets to probe LLMs' spatial and temporal understanding capabilities.

stories.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
stories.author: Tao Yang
bullet_points: Introduces CoinRAG, a new method to optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
Addresses the inefficiency of processing long, redundant contexts by reusing KV caches at a more granular level (information nuggets).
Aims to improve accuracy while maintaining low prefill latency, optimizing the Pareto frontier for long-context RAG.

stories.title: SkillProx: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Proximal Textual Gradient Descent
stories.author: Yike Guo
bullet_points: Introduces SkillProx, a method for self-evolving LLM agent skills using Proximal Textual Gradient Descent.
Addresses limitations in current skill refinement methods by incorporating explicit diagnosis-outcome feedback.
Proposes a dedicated mechanism for skill deletion, moving beyond generic text editing operations.

stories.title: SABRE: Scalable and Automated Benchmarking of VLMs under Stress
stories.author: Jiawei Zhou
bullet_points: Introduces SABRE, a new pipeline designed to automate the creation of stress tests for Vision-Language Models (VLMs).
Addresses the gap where VLM development is outpacing the creation of robust benchmarking tools.
SABRE converts high-level Markdown task designs into structured specifications, images, and Q&A pairs for rigorous testing.

stories.title: ResidencyRL: Reinforcement Learning in Simulated Clinical Environments
stories.author: Lin Yang
bullet_points: The research proposes 'ResidencyRL,' applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to simulate clinical environments.
It addresses the gap where LLMs perform well on static benchmarks but struggle with dynamic clinical reasoning during patient encounters.
The goal is to model the complex process of clinical expertise development, mirroring physician residency training.

stories.title: GeoBenchLLM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Geo-Related Tasks
stories.author: Lynda Tamine
bullet_points: Introduces GeoBenchLLM, a new comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLMs on geo-related tasks.
Addresses a limitation in current LLM research by moving beyond homogeneous settings to test generalization capabilities in geodata.
Evaluates various LLMs using twelve diverse, publicly available datasets covering geo-spatial and temporal understanding.

stories.title: LitTraceQA: A Benchmark for Multi-Stage Grounding and Verification in Scientific Question Answering
stories.author: Krzysztof Czarnecki
bullet_points: Introduces LitTraceQA, a new benchmark specifically designed for scientific question answering.
Addresses the critical need for language models to move beyond fluent generation to reliable evidence grounding in scientific literature.
Focuses on the multi-stage task of identifying relevant papers and locating concrete supporting evidence.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer: 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows
stories.author: riordan
bullet_points: Introduction of 'Muse Glimmer,' a new 30B-parameter language model.
The model is specifically optimized for 'always-on local agent workflows,' suggesting edge or personal computing applications.
The announcement originates from Hacker News, indicating interest within the developer/tech community.

stories.title: When Your AI Agent Passes 2,283 Tests — And Still Fails in Production
stories.author: dengyier
bullet_points: Highlights the gap between rigorous testing (2,283+ tests) and real-world AI agent performance.
Discusses a specific production bug and a protocol-design insight shared by the community.
Touches upon the role of cryptography in the context of AI system failures.
